jobs.title: Senior Officer - Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Lead AR and AP on Yardi Voyager across the lease-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles. Act as Finance's process owner in Yardi and drive system improvements and automation. Having minimum experience of 8-10years and ready to join in 1 month period.

Key Responsibilities

AR: Manage Billing, process receipt batches and prepayments, maintain tenant ledgers, and handle PDCs, tenant aging, write-offs and adjustments.
Move-outs: Oversee security deposit reconciliation and final account statements.
Owner accounting: Run management fee calculations, owner statements and owner distributions and remittances.
AP: Manage payable batches, PO and invoice matching (PAY scan or Procure to Pay), payment processing, payables aging and vendor reconciliations.
GL and close: Oversee journal entries, accruals, pre-payments and reconciliations.
Reporting: Maintain account trees and GL mapping and validate financial and YSR reports.
Automation: Utilize Yardi
automation to cut manual work and reduce errors
Systems: Partner with the ERP team on enhancements, UAT and integrations.
Compliance: Knowledge of IFRS in Real Estate Accounting.

jobs.company: Asociación Española de Empleo con Apoyo - AESE
jobs.title: Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Risk Analyst at Asociación Española de Empleo con Apoyo (AESE) will work part time in a remote capacity, supporting the organization in identifying, assessing, and monitoring financial and operational risks. This role involves analyzing data from various programs and funding sources, preparing risk reports, and recommending mitigation strategies to support decision-making. The Risk Analyst will collaborate with internal stakeholders to review risk exposures, refine controls, and help develop policies that align with AESE’s mission and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day activities include conducting risk assessments, tracking key risk indicators, contributing to risk documentation, and providing clear, data-driven insights to management.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Statistics abilities to interpret data, identify trends, and support evidence-based risk assessments.
Candidates should possess Risk Analysis expertise to evaluate exposure, perform qualitative and quantitative assessments, and propose mitigation measures.
Candidates should possess Finance knowledge to understand budgets, funding streams, and financial impacts of risk scenarios.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present findings clearly, prepare reports, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
Relevant experience in risk management, compliance, or data analysis, ideally within non-profit or social services environments.
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic data analysis tools; familiarity with risk assessment frameworks is an advantage.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage part-time hours effectively, and meet deadlines.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
